fetch.note: SmartNews decides how often it fetches. One hour is News Distribution's own guess, used only to say when a fetch is later than usual.

logo.size.note: SmartNews recommends a 700 x 100 PNG with a transparent background, in a dark and a light version. Read on a third-party summary (RebelMouse); the SmartNews specification could not be fetched.

logo.dark.note: SmartNews recommends adding a dark-mode logo. Same third-party source as the logo size.

logo.required.note: News Distribution asks for a logo before it saves the brand details, so the feed always carries one. It is not stated as a SmartNews requirement.

description.length.note: SmartNews recommends fewer than 30 characters for the site description. Same third-party source.

thumbnail.size.note: A warning when the long edge of a thumbnail is under 1,500 px. The 1,500 px figure could not be confirmed against SmartNews, so it is News Distribution's own threshold. The article stays in the feed.

item.thumbnail.note: An item needs a thumbnail. Articles without a featured image are left out of this feed. SmartNews's own specification could not be fetched to confirm it.

item.author.note: Every item carries an author. When WordPress holds no person's name, News Distribution uses the newsroom name from the author settings.

url.missing.note: Every item needs the article address.

body.empty.note: An article with no text has nothing to send in content:encoded.

feed.format.note: One SmartFormat feed per language: RSS 2.0 in UTF-8 with the content, dc, media and snf namespaces. The namespace addresses are written from public descriptions of SmartFormat; the specification itself could not be fetched.

feed.size.note: News Distribution keeps the feed to about 100 items and under 1 MB. It could not confirm a SmartNews limit, so this is its own habit.

item.canonical.note: The link of an item is the article's canonical address, with utm_ and other tracking parameters removed.

item.date.note: Dates are written in RFC 822 form with a time zone, as RSS 2.0 asks.

item.fulltext.note: The full text and the lead image go in content:encoded.

item.deleted.note: An unpublished or deleted article stays in the feed for 3 days with media:status state="deleted". The deletion marker is written from public descriptions of SmartFormat and could not be confirmed against the specification.

ttl.hint.note: News Distribution writes ttl into the feed as a hint. SmartNews decides how often it fetches, so it is not a promise.
